findings.resolution: Short segments use positioned T labels and a complete readable legend without altering interval or balance geometry. Rechecked trace and budget in every state/profile.
Retained pool body/policy/owner remain unobscured at the copy endpoint; Incoming coverage during the action preserves the staging source. Rechecked tail-sampling state and motion in every profile.
Matrix and sequence coordinate labels occupy layout space above resident values. Rechecked collection, async lag, OCC, and child budget in every state/profile.

Ordinary causal weights produce the contaminated output; cross-example logits become −∞ before a new normalization, and isolated output remains beside the ordinary output. Explicit numerical contribution and all original values remain legible.
Some identifiers and long state words wrap within narrow cells. Complete characters remain visible and coordinate labels remain separate from resident values; no material clipping found.

manual_inspection.motion_method: Inspected all 32 fresh whole-component in-flight PNGs using native-width paired contacts, one causally meaningful action per lesson in every profile. Real Next/Pause/Finish retained the prior committed state during the sampled action and finished at the exact authored target. Sampling covers selected times recorded per sample, not every transition or instant.
